title: Derived adjunction of a ringed sequence projection
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ an inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Write $\mathscr S(B)$ for strict semilinear systems of module sheaves, with componentwise exactness, identified with modules over $B$ on the sequence site $\mathcal T=\mathcal C\times\mathbf N_{\ge1}$ [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Use unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with compatible maps $A\to B_n$. Let $p:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal T),B)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),A)$ have inverse image on underlying sheaves the constant sequence, with ring map given by $A\to B_n$. The functors $Lp^*:D(A)\to D(\mathscr S(B))$ and $Rp_*:D(\mathscr S(B))\to D(A)$ exist and form a canonical adjunction. Its Hom bijection is the derived fraction extension of the ordinary correspondence $h:P\to p_*N\mapsto(x\otimes b\mapsto b\pi_nh(x))_n$. For one flat-term K-flat representative $Q\to P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], $Lp^*P$ is represented by the strict complex $(Q\otimes_A B_n)_n$, naturally in derived $P$. Ordinary direct image is $p_*N=\lim_n\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B_n}N_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].
